hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.kt|*.kts) K=$(command -v ktfmt 2>/dev/null || { [ -x /opt/homebrew/bin/ktfmt ] && echo /opt/homebrew/bin/ktfmt; } || { [ -x /usr/local/bin/ktfmt ] && echo /usr/local/bin/ktfmt; }); [ -n "$K" ] && "$K" --kotlinlang-style "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
